conflicts.ce_equivalent: ManimCE does not support custom moderngl shader folders directly on Mobjects in this manner. One would have to use custom OpenGLMobject or custom shader wrappers which are structured differently.
ManimCE uses a different updater and attribute system; custom uniforms are not natively exposed on standard Mobjects without custom shader boilerplate.

conflicts.gl_construct: data_dtype with custom numpy structured arrays for points
conflicts.ce_equivalent: ManimCE uses standard numpy arrays for points and does not expose raw vertex attribute layout customization easily to the user.
